### What this changes and why

### Checks

- [ ] `npm run typecheck`, `npm test` and `npm run bench` pass
- [ ] A change people running it would notice has a line in `CHANGELOG.md` (under a new version heading)
- [ ] The README and `docs/` say what's now true
- [ ] No keys, install URLs, or real titles, file names or ids in code, tests or docs: made-up ones only
